worldcombat.skill.psychicterrain.summary: Raise a psychic field over the chosen ground: grounded bodies on it cannot be hit by priority moves from others and their Psychic attacks hit harder. It treats both sides alike.
worldcombat.skill.psychicterrain.use.0: Shut down the foe's priority moves
worldcombat.skill.psychicterrain.use.2: Screen the team before trading priority hits
worldcombat.skill.psychicterrain.descrip: Raises a psychic field of radius %1$s blocks on the chosen ground, lasting %2$s; only grounded bodies standing inside are marked by it.
A marked body has its Psychic-type damaging moves multiplied by %1$s, and damage from a priority move aimed at it by another source is wiped out.
The mark lasts only while the body stands inside; it ends the moment the body leaves the field or the field expires.
Starts up in %1$s and settles in %2$s, both driven by Speed.
worldcombat.skill.psychicterrain.form.0: Focused home field: smaller (radius x0.82) and longer (x1.25) with the boost raised to x1.45, at the cost of +3 ticks start-up and x1.2 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.psychicterrain.form.1: Ward: wider (radius x1.25) with -2 ticks start-up and x0.9 cooldown, at the cost of a x1.15 boost and x0.85 life.
worldcombat.skill.psychicterrain.timing: Cast at ground within %1$s blocks; after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP to press the psionics in, recovers %3$s, and commits a %5$s cooldown on cast.
At level %1$s the committed cooldown drops to %2$s s.
At level %1$s the committed cooldown drops again to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.psychicterrain.prefere: On = focused: radius x0.82, life x1.25, Psychic boost x1.45, at the cost of +3 ticks start-up and x1.2 cooldown. Off = ward: radius x1.25, -2 ticks start-up, x0.9 cooldown, at the cost of a x1.15 boost and x0.85 life.
The companion lays the field only while a threat is within this distance; lower lays it up close, higher sets it up in advance.
Push the field at the foe
On, the field is pressed between you and the threat to screen the fighting line. Off, it is pressed at your feet to shield yourself first.
On, a companion holding its station will step out to lay the field.
